tokens.name: bg

tokens.usage: Raised preview and board surfaces; pair with text and muted.

tokens.usage: Interactive surfaces; pair with text.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on bg, surface, surface-strong, board-cell, and accent-soft.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on bg, surface, and surface-strong.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative container separators; do not use as the only control or focus indicator.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Original cyan brand color from the app website; decorative marks only. White small text on this color does not reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Original dark cyan from the app website; identity ink.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Original paper tint; decorative identity swatch.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Original warm accent; decorative identity swatch, not text or focus.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Links on bg and surface; filled primary actions with on-action. This intentional semantic addition improves text contrast.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet selected surfaces; pair with text or action.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid keyboard focus outline on bg, surface, and surface-strong.

tokens.name: board-cell
tokens.usage: Sudoku cells; pair with text, action, and board-line.

tokens.name: board-peer
tokens.usage: Related Sudoku cells; pair with text.

tokens.name: board-selected
tokens.usage: Selected Sudoku cell; pair with text or action.

tokens.name: board-rule
tokens.usage: Major Sudoku separators on board-cell.

tokens.name: board-line
tokens.usage: Minor Sudoku separators on board-cell; at least 3:1 contrast.

tokens.name: error

meta.intentionalAdditions: Focus website refresh: semantic action/focus colors, accessible board separators, unified responsive light/dark surfaces. Original cyan, dark cyan, paper and gold retained.
